opis: Squirrel's cosy home from the reference picture (the same warm walls, the round window, the row of hooks on the wall), in warm evening light. On the hooks hang a red hat, a long striped scarf and a little backpack. In the middle a small round wooden table with a checked tablecloth; on it ONE big golden APPLE PIE just out of the oven, steaming, one slice cut out, and a wicker basket full of red apples. The SQUIRREL, wearing oven mitts, proudly sets the pie down; the FOX holds a plate with a slice of pie and smiles; the BUNNY licks his lips with a fork in his paw. Cosy, happy and calm - friends together after a day of picking apples.
